name: Snake
tagline: Two snakes on one grid. Send the link — no server.
description:
Send the Invite in the bar above the game. A friend opens the link and drops onto the same board as you — two snakes, one apple, last one still moving wins. No account, no install, no game server. The room is the link.

On your own it is the classic: eat, grow, don't hit the wall. Arrows or WASD on a computer; swipe or the pad on a phone. Your best length lives in the file, so the copy you keep is the save.

An unofficial port of JavaScript Snake by patorjk.
